test_cases.description: Find a tracked container by container number.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the synthetic review fixture container CAIU1234567 in my Terminal49 account and summarize its current status.
test_cases.expected_output: If the fixture exists in the connected account, returns matching container identifiers, status, shipping line, and available terminal information. Otherwise, clearly reports zero matches without inventing shipment data.

test_cases.description: List a bounded page of containers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the first 10 containers in my Terminal49 account.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 10 container records, clearly labels the page as unfiltered, and indicates pagination or result limits.

test_cases.description: List actively tracked shipments without nested containers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the first 10 shipments where shipping-line tracking has not stopped. Do not include nested containers.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 10 shipments matching tracking_stopped=false without nested container relationships, with pagination details.

test_cases.description: Check whether a shipping line is supported before tracking.
test_cases.user_prompt: Does Terminal49 support tracking containers for Ocean Network Express?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching supported shipping lines with their SCAC codes and names.

test_cases.description: Create a tracking request for a container that is not already tracked.
test_cases.user_prompt: Track the synthetic review fixture container CAIU1234567 with carrier SCAC MAEU in my Terminal49 account.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the existing matching container, creates a tracking request, or clearly reports that no request was created because the number/carrier could not be resolved. It must not claim the fixture exists or is pending unless the account response confirms that state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Los Angeles tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because general weather is outside Terminal49's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for freight-rate purchasing or quoting.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book the cheapest trucking rate from Los Angeles to Phoenix.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not quote, purchase, or book transportation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger an unsupported destructive action.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete all completed shipments from my account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no shipment-deletion capability.
